Tailored to accommodate various entrance layouts and aesthetic preferences, our products cater to large entrances as well as revolving doors.

Additionally, we offer customization options such as embedding logos and branding into our aluminium mats to enhance branding at ground level.

Each option includes efficient surface finishes for dirt and moisture removal, ensuring durability and a premium visual appeal.

settings.title: Do I need an aluminium mat product?
settings.row_content: Aluminium floormats stand out as being at the top of the pyramid when it comes to floor matting systems. They are highly functional first stage dirt-barriers at high-traffic entrances, are low-maintenance and offer premium aesthetics with the longest durability. So if these advantages are what you are looking for, UltiGrate Aluminium Matting System may just be right for you.

And since we manufacture all mat components inhouse in India, we will promptly replace them for you in your existing aluminium mat frames at a fractional cost of your original investment. You may even opt for a change in color and type of the new mat infills, for a refreshing new look!

settings.title: Are there any regulatory guidelines on commercial entrance matting?
settings.row_content:
The Americans with Disabilities Act sets specific codes regulations for public and commercial buildings so that people with a wide range of disabilities can freely and easily access all areas of these buildings. The ADA even has very specific guidelines on entrance mats. The best mats for wheelchairs are our recessed metal mats and our surface-mount mats, which ensure easy access to all who enter your facility.

The ADA has these set of guidelines:

Carpet must be securely affixed to the ground, have a stiff or no backing at all, and be no more than 12.5mm thick. If the carpet is more than 12.5mm thick, there must be a beveled edge for wheels to effortlessly glide over.

Recessed entrance grates/mats need to have less than 12.5mm between pieces to prevent wheels or any other movement facilitating equipment to get caught.

UltiGrate satisfies all ADA regulatory guidelines.

What Are Aluminium Mats?

Aluminium mats are heavy-duty floor mats made from strong aluminium frames and durable inserts. These inserts can be made of carpet, rubber, or brush strips, depending on where the mat will be used. They are placed at the entrances of buildings to trap dust, mud, and moisture from shoes. The main job of an aluminium mat is to stop dirt at the door. This keeps your indoor floors clean and helps your flooring last longer. They also add a touch of class to your entrance and reduce the risk of slips and falls.

Why Choose Aluminium Mats for Your Commercial Space?

  • They Handle Heavy Traffic: Made for busy buildings, they last through thousands of footsteps.
  • They Keep Your Floors Clean: Trap dirt, water, and dust before it spreads inside.
  • They Can Keep People Safe: Reduce slipping hazards caused by wet shoes.
  • They Last Years: Made from tough aluminium and quality inserts.
  • They are Stylish: Custom options available with logo and color branding.
